wall_clock_rule: spec: wall clock includes LLM latency and compilation. An E-LLM row's wall_clock_s times the runtime only, so the latency of its compile calls (from the cell's cassette, llm_latency.jsonl) is added; the row's own value is kept as wall_clock_s_row. A cell resumed from its cassette after a stop served the recorded calls without waiting, so its wall clock under-states by their latency; such cells are counted in llm_accounting.resumed_cells.
